Regulation: B.C. Reg. 86/2026
Made under: Property Transfer Tax Act
Published in: No. 10 – B.C. Regs. 83 to 93, June 2, 2026
Deposit date: May 22, 2026

B.C. Reg. 86/2026, deposited May 22, 2026, under thePROPERTY TRANSFER TAX ACT[section 37]. Order in Council 198/2026, approved and ordered May 22, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that the Property Transfer Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 74/88, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — B. BAILEY,Minister of Finance; L. BEARE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 16 of the Property Transfer Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 74/88, is amended by striking out "under section 19 of theAssessment Act" in both places. minutes_briefs.title: Property Transfer Tax Regulation amended: removes outdated Assessment Act references
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended its Property Transfer Tax Regulation (the rules that govern the tax paid when property changes hands). The change removes references to 'section 19 of the Assessment Act' from the regulation. This is a technical cleanup that updates the regulation to reflect current law, and it does not change the tax rates or who has to pay the tax.
minutes_briefs.action_required: No action needed — this is a technical amendment that does not change tax rates or filing requirements.
minutes_briefs.industries: Landlord & Property Mgmt, Construction & Development, Professional Services
